title: Specify the matter-trigger to personal-assistant review handoff
summary: Define a small versioned adapter contract where a Matter/JEV material-change trigger wakes the user-specific assistant for optional deeper investigation and a decision about reporting or interruption. This internal review is distinct from an end-user alert and from the existing capture/delivery baseline. The discussion has not frozen fields, thresholds or an assistant runtime.
in_scope: Internal review request and typed review result semantics, with exact source/context/access and outcome provenance.
A bounded single assistant pass using existing host tools, separate from consequential publication or production delivery.
Both immediate decisive-event and accumulated-context review triggers are required; scoring semantics, thresholds, review outcomes and assistant runtime remain unresolved.
out_of_scope: Implementation, provider/tool execution, client-data processing or deployment as part of this planning commit.
New assistant/model client, MCP server, tool wizard, source index, database, queue or general orchestration framework where existing owners supply the capability.
Changing frozen monitoring 1.0/1.1 semantics silently; production alerts, formal qualification, DIAT or unrelated Oil work.
implementation: Inspect MAT-022 investigation, MAT-023 queries, MAT-028 packets, MAT-030 receipts, MAT-072 egress and the existing MAT-082/084 adapters before defining the smallest missing handoff. Locate existing host assistant/wizard entry points with its owner; do not invent an endpoint or service.

Bind a review request to user/workspace/optional-client, approved intent and angle/context versions, continuing matter/material change, authorized citations and availability cut, actual prior communication, why flagged, uncertainty and explicit read/call/time/byte/cost limits. Proposed field names remain draft.

Specify internal wake-up, assistant review/quiet notes, report preparation, user delivery, consumption and action as distinct receipts. Define exact duplicate handling, cancellation and unknown model/tool outcomes without blind retry or baseline advancement.

Let JEV supply source/change interpretations and let the personal assistant assess current user work and whether to report or interrupt. Avoid repeating the same full analysis; decide what model-derived outputs remain unqualified in capture-only rehearsal.

Retain current access, original tokens and fresh source/context/control checks before and after tool/model work and at any eventual host capture. Direct pause/revoke/edit uses host controls immediately.

Negotiate any new adapter contract explicitly beside frozen 1.0/1.1. Record open choices instead of reinterpreting existing AlertDelivery/capture records as internal work or assuming production permission.

Support two trigger paths under the approved client/objective/angle: a decisive development can immediately wake the assistant even with no prior accumulation (owner example: highly relevant and directly adverse to the client interests); distinct smaller developments can accumulate or become materially significant together when a later event arrives. Both request assistant review, not an automatic human alert.

Retain the owner 24 percent accumulated plus 75 percent new-action illustration without treating the numbers as calibrated JEV probabilities, a fixed additive importance score, or a selected boundary. Define policy meaning and boundary behavior explicitly before implementation; do not reinterpret the existing 1.1 capture-policy decision regions.

acceptance.criterion: A trigger can wake review without claiming the user was informed.
acceptance.verification: Write compatibility examples for internal wake-up, reviewed-quiet, report proposed, alert proposed and unavailable/unknown; show separate baseline and outcome receipts. The result vocabulary is proposed until reviewed.

acceptance.criterion: Review retains the existing authorization and freshness boundary.
acceptance.verification: Specify refusal checks for foreign client, unapproved intent, revoked source/tool access, changed angle, future evidence and in-flight pause; do not expose contact or unrelated client notes by default.

acceptance.criterion: The first contract slice is bounded and reusable without new infrastructure.
acceptance.verification: Pin real existing assistant/tool entry points and existing Matter APIs; demonstrate a one-pass capture-only example with explicit budget and unknown/recovery semantics. Do not require MAT-040 labels merely to exercise exploratory review.

acceptance.criterion: Both decisive and cumulative developments can request review with an explainable trigger route.
acceptance.verification: Specify cases for immediate review from zero prior pressure, smaller distinct developments below a proposed boundary, a later development making the combination review-worthy, and an event eligible for both routes producing one review request. Fixture thresholds are explicitly illustrative until approved; waking the assistant never fabricates delivery.

tests: Wake-up alone does not advance communicated/captured-for-user knowledge.
A decisive new source correction or deadline can request fresh review despite an earlier quiet/handled decision.
A failed or unavailable review is unknown, not an irrelevance judgment.
A decisive client-adverse development does not wait for accumulation.
One later fact can change the interpretation of earlier quiet findings; do not require keyword counts to reach a universal threshold.
risks: Treating a bubble burst as delivery can fabricate the user baseline.
A universal importance score or unbounded agent loop would recreate complexity before usefulness is shown.

reuse.application: Reuse bounded acquisition, exact evidence inspection and durable attempt semantics.
Reuse source/context guards and preserve frozen capture semantics; this is a separately negotiated assistant port.

sources: Owner discussion, 2026-10-31: client onboarding research; bubble burst wakes the user-specific assistant; bounded existing MCP/wizard investigation; report/alert judgment; quiet findings retained per user/client/angle for cascading JEV. Ticket writing only; unresolved choices remain proposals.

Owner, 2026-10-31: both immediate and accumulated triggers; client-adverse pin-prick or distinct signals plus a tipping event. The 24% + 75% example is illustrative, not calibrated probability arithmetic.
